events.description: The BBC Singers, led by conductor Krista Audere, perform Parry's Songs of Farewell, his profoundly moving cycle of wartime laments for a lost age.

events.title: Vivaldi Four Seasons by Candlelight

events.title: The Monteverdi Choir and English Baroque Soloists: Handel's Theodora
events.description: Handel loved Theodora more than any of his other oratorios, and with Iestyn Davies singing in this concert staging with the Monteverdi Choir, you're about to hear why.

events.title: I Fagiolini: Monteverdi L'Orfeo
events.description: L'Orfeo: Monteverdi's pioneering opera, brought to vibrant, heart-melting life by Robert Hollingworth and the virtuoso singers of I Fagiolini.

events.title: Handel Messiah by Candlelight
events.description: Enjoy a candlelit performance of Part I of Handel's Messiah as St Martin's Chamber Choir and St Martin's Chamber Ensemble bring this beloved masterpiece to life.

events.title: Great Sacred Music: American Thanksgiving

events.description: Darbar brings the classical music of South India to St Martin-in-the-Fields. Carnatic vocalist Varsha Ramann is joined by violin and mridangam for an hour of composition, rhythmic cycle and improvisation made in the room — a tradition heard at close quarters, on its own terms.

events.title: Nathaniel Mander, harpsichord
events.description: A programme of Bach's Preludes and Fugues on the instrument for which they were originally written and alongside the added gems of Handel and Mozart.

events.title: Ballet Music by Candlelight

events.title: Choral Classics: Advent

events.title: BBC Singers and Britten Sinfonia: Britten St Nicholas
events.description: Benjamin Britten lives! 50 years to the day since his death in 1976, the Britten Sinfonia and BBC Singers unleash the irrepressible life-force of Britten's St Nicholas, the story of the saint who inspired the figure of Santa Claus.

events.title: Joy to the World: A Christmas Concert

events.title: Academy of St Martin in the Fields and Sterling Elliott
events.description: Cellist Sterling Elliott joins the Academy of St Martin in the Fields, performing music by Joseph Haydn, Robert Schumann, Antonín Dvořák, and Johannes Brahms.

events.title: Dido and Aeneas by Candlelight
events.description: St Martin's Choral Scholars, Emerging Artists and Youth Choir present a concert performance of this early gem of English opera, telling the tragic tale of Queen Dido and the Trojan hero Aeneas.

events.title: The Mozartists: Mozart in 1777
events.description: The Mozartists' ground-breaking MOZART 250 series comes of age as they explore Mozart's output from 1777, the year in which he turned twenty-one.

events.title: Nonsuch Singers: Monteverdi Vespers – 50th Anniversary Concert
events.description: Celebrate 50 years of Nonsuch Singers with Monteverdi's magnificent Vespers of 1610 in the glorious setting of St Martin-in-the-Fields.

events.title: Tenebrae: Path of Miracles
events.description: Join Nigel Short and Tenebrae on the road to Santiago as they celebrate their 25th season by performing Joby Talbot's epic Path of Miracles – entirely from memory.

events.title: Family Classics: Myths and Legends
events.description: Our family classics concerts offer the chance for children and adults of all ages to come together in a short 45-minute programme of popular classical music, including a few favourites for you to join in with!

events.title: Vivaldi Four Seasons by Candlelight
events.description: Step into an evening of music and candlelight as St Martin's Chamber Ensemble brings Vivaldi's exhilarating Four Seasons to life.

events.title: Choral Discovery: Enchanted Lands
events.description: Journey through a world of myth, magic and mystery in Enchanted Lands – a musical exploration of folklore, poetry and spirituality across cultures and landscapes.

events.title: Songs of Summer
events.description: Celebrate the Songs of Summer with St Martin's Chamber Choir in an afternoon of sunshine, nature and birdsong, featuring music by Finzi, Rutter, Gershwin and many others.

events.title: Baroque Classics by Candlelight
events.description: An intimate candlelit evening of Baroque favourites by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Tartini, and others.

events.title: Vivaldi Four Seasons by Candlelight
events.description: Violin virtuoso Miki Takahashi gives her acclaimed interpretation of Vivaldi's magnificent masterpiece The Four Seasons in the beautiful, candlelit splendour of St Martins Church, accompanied by the Baroque Chamber Orchestra of London.

events.title: Orchestral Classics by Candlelight
events.description: A sparkling candlelit journey through orchestral favourites from Elgar and Dvořák to Sibelius, Grieg and Tchaikovsky. St Martin's Chamber Ensemble, conducted by Olivia Price, brings these classics vividly to life.

events.title: Vivaldi Four Seasons by Candlelight
events.description: St Martin's Chamber Ensemble presents Vivaldi Four Seasons by Candlelight, featuring Mozart, Purcell, Sirmen, and Vivaldi.
